title: STREAM4 KV landing Option M (KV_MAP=1): each KV sector streams from the HBM stack of its destination tiles' die quadrant
decision: owner 2026-10-06 (Qwen ROM CLOSED): Option M adopted in the recorded configuration; die r19/r20 per-stack quadrant crossbar kept as built
why: The die's per-stack KV crossbar (r19/r20 qfd_kvc) feeds only the tiles of its own quadrant. On the base map (KV_MAP=0) a stack's sectors land on tiles of every quadrant: 131062 of 196592 slice writes leave the quadrant, so the as-built crossbar would deliver only 65530 of them (1/3). Option M re-stripes the KV so every sector comes from the stack of its destination quadrant: 0 of 196592 slice writes leave the quadrant and each stack carries exactly 25% of the beats.

exactness.KV_MAP_1: 15/15 PASS, slices and token HBM codes exact (logs/all_m1.log)
exactness.negative_control: KV_MAP=1 service with KV_MAP_HBM=0 backend: ISO_P8191 FAIL (timeout after 1,568 of 131,072 sectors: the service rejects every off-map landed sector) as expected (logs/iso_neg.log)

token_cost.basis: measured RTL, charged in full: the token's only exposed KV fill is the cold first layer (L0 fill_exposed 1,363 per die in the measured base-map token; layers 1-35 expose 0). Option M delays that cold layer's KV-ready by at most the isolated ISO_P8191 kv_ok delta (+54; the fill itself +8). Steady layers stay fully hidden in early_go + posted mode (0 exposed, both maps).

modelled_not_composed.status: MODELLED, not RTL: cycle model of the die r19 per-stack crossbar + 768-b row fabric on the measured KV_MAP=1 landing trace (rows_768b_ins8_fifo64, busiest row 85.6%); hidden in steady layers, charged only as a labelled sensitivity on the cold first layer

physical: qfd_kvc / qfd_kvc_n (the per-stack crossbar) is one of the die masters checked with assumed-constant timing views (results/rtl/qwen_rom_die_r17_20261005/element_views/views_r20c.json); no routed closure of the crossbar exists
